title: Head Model V1.5
description: The head of an avatar as the propagation of its speech needs it, in its simplest, parametric form: a sphere, the mouth in front of the characteristic point of the face that gives the avatar's Spatial Attitude, and the radiation of the speech as a dipole.

CharacteristicPoint.description: The point of the face whose Spatial Attitude the Head Model is relative to.

HeadRadius.description: Metres, of the sphere that is the head.

MouthPosition.description: X ahead, Y left, Z up, in metres, from the characteristic point, in the frame of the head.

SpeechDipoleWeight.description: How the speech radiates from the mouth: 0 equally in all directions, 0.5 a cardioid (forward), 1 a dipole (forward and backward).

SpeechDipolePower.description: How focused that shape is; 0 equally in all directions, whatever the weight.
